leadText:
Mollie (Japanese: ミカ Mika) is a character of the day who appeared in What I Did for Love!. She is a rookie Pokémon Coordinator who made her Pokémon Contest debut at the Gardenia Town event.

Mollie seemed to have trouble finding out where to register until told her it was at the front desk. Her 's Appeals performance helped Mollie advance to the second round. She used , but the two lost to Brock and his .

In the end, Top Coordinator Yuma decided to take Mollie under her wing and develop her Coordinator potential, as she felt that Mollie needed more advice than Brock.
